```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
combine <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "combine") |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(combine_position_group(pos), pos_levels))
combine_years <- range(combine$season)
combine_span <- paste0(combine_years[1], " to ", combine_years[2], " combines")
measures <- explorer_combine_measures()
# Special teams invitees rarely run the 40, so separation compares the other eight.
sep_levels <- setdiff(pos_levels, "Special teams")
claim_fill <- "#374151"
context_fill <- "#9CA3AF"
q <- function(x, p) unname(stats::quantile(x, p, na.rm = TRUE))

long <- combine |>
  select(season, player_name, school, pos, position_group, all_of(measures$key)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(measures$key), names_to = "key", values_to = "value") |>
  left_join(select(measures, key, label, unit), by = "key")
spread <- long |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  group_by(position_group, key, label, unit) |>
  summarise(lo = q(value, 0.25), med = stats::median(value), hi = q(value, 0.75), .groups = "drop")
boxes <- spread |>
  filter(key %in% c("weight", "forty"), position_group %in% sep_levels) |>
  select(position_group, key, lo, hi) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = c(lo, hi))
overlaps <- function(a_lo, a_hi, b_lo, b_hi) a_lo <= b_hi & b_lo <= a_hi
pairs <- tidyr::expand_grid(a = seq_len(nrow(boxes)), b = seq_len(nrow(boxes))) |>
  filter(a < b) |>
  mutate(
    pair = paste(boxes$position_group[a], "and", tolower(boxes$position_group[b])),
    overlap = overlaps(boxes$lo_weight[a], boxes$hi_weight[a], boxes$lo_weight[b], boxes$hi_weight[b]) &
      overlaps(boxes$lo_forty[a], boxes$hi_forty[a], boxes$lo_forty[b], boxes$hi_forty[b])
  )
overlap_groups <- unique(c(
  as.character(boxes$position_group[pairs$a[pairs$overlap]]),
  as.character(boxes$position_group[pairs$b[pairs$overlap]])
))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- boxes |>
  mutate(
    in_overlap = position_group %in% overlap_groups,
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: weight %.0f to %.0f lb, forty-yard dash %.2f to %.2f s",
      position_group,
      lo_weight,
      hi_weight,
      lo_forty,
      hi_forty
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_rect_interactive(
    aes(
      xmin = lo_weight,
      xmax = hi_weight,
      ymin = lo_forty,
      ymax = hi_forty,
      fill = position_group,
      colour = in_overlap,
      tooltip = tip,
      data_id = position_group
    ),
    alpha = 0.35,
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = (lo_weight + hi_weight) / 2,
      y = (lo_forty + hi_forty) / 2,
      label = position_group
    ),
    colour = "#111827",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = context_fill, `TRUE` = claim_fill), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Do any two position groups share a middle half on weight and the forty-yard dash?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Boxes span each group's middle half, ",
      combine_span,
      "; overlapping groups in dark grey"
    ),
    x = "Weight (lb)",
    y = "Forty-yard dash (s)",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "combine-position-size-and-speed", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: invitees
points <- combine |>
  filter(!is.na(forty), !is.na(weight), position_group %in% sep_levels) |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s (%s, %s), %s: %s lb, forty in %.2f s",
      player_name,
      pos,
      school,
      season,
      weight,
      forty
    )
  )
p_points <- ggplot(points, aes(weight, forty, colour = position_group)) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(player_name, season)),
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_colour_position() +
  labs(
    title = "Every invitee's weight and forty-yard dash",
    subtitle = "Each point is one invitee with both measurables recorded",
    x = "Weight (lb)",
    y = "Forty-yard dash (s)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)))
card_interactive(p_points, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```
